value.rationale: The canonical even-power planar balls interpolate between a disk (index 3) and a square (index 2); an exact all-q Fourier-mean phase diagram is a natural unknown invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The theorem singles out exactly four axes in an interval where all nonaxial directions retain finite Fourier-mean radius; the explicit gamma pole coefficient quantifies a genuinely singular geometric transition and permits calibration of future estimates for flat curvature endpoints. No general new Fourier estimate is claimed, and mere numerical repeatability is not treated as value.
